evidence_sentence: If the file is too small or the signature is incorrect, it throws an exception.
rationale: The fixed implementation uniquely adds a file-size check (rejecting blobs smaller than 61 bytes) after validating the PNG signature. The vulnerable implementation checks only whether at least 8 bytes were read for the signature and does not reject an otherwise signature-valid file merely because it is too small for a PNG datastream. The docstring explicitly describes the fixed-only size validation.
rewritten_docstring: The function begins by validating the input parameters and logging the entry event. It opens the image file and checks for a valid PNG signature, throwing an exception if the signature is incorrect. Memory is allocated for a MngInfo structure, which is initialized and used to read the PNG image data. After reading, it checks the image dimensions and colorspace, adjusting the colorspace if necessary. Finally, it logs the exit event and returns the image or NULL in case of errors.
